# Third-party notices

**Generated by `scripts/New-ThirdPartyNotices.ps1`. Do not edit by hand.**
The gate regenerates it and fails if this file has drifted, so an edit here
is a change that will be reverted by the next run rather than kept.

BachelorPad+ Lite is distributed under GPL-3.0-only (ADR-0071). It statically
links the 624 crates below, and this file passes on their terms as that
licence requires. Listed here is what is actually shipped: the dependency
graph walked from the `bachelorpad` binary along normal and build edges only,
never dev edges -- a test-only crate is in no artefact anybody downloads.

## Slint, which is why the licence is what it is

The user interface is built with [Slint](https://slint.dev), which is offered
under three licences at the copyright holder's election:
`GPL-3.0-only OR LicenseRef-Slint-Royalty-free-2.0 OR LicenseRef-Slint-Software-3.0`.

**This project elects GPL-3.0-only**, and takes `-only` rather than `-or-later`
for that reason: Slint's grant is to version 3 and no other, so a project
offering "or later" would be offering terms it has not been granted.
